environment.description: NestJS microservice deployed on a standard EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2) running in a VPC with no egress filtering. Instance has IAM role attached with ec2:DescribeInstances and s3:GetObject permissions. SELinux is in permissive mode (setenforce 0 was run during deployment for compatibility). The service runs as the node user with standard filesystem access. Instance metadata service v1 (IMDSv1) is enabled. No network-level restrictions on outbound requests from the application container.
